title: PAD4-DB v1.0: A Curated Structure-Activity Resource for PAD4 Inhibitors
description: PAD4-DB is a standardized, deduplicated knowledge base of 3,093 structurally resolved PAD4 (PADI4) inhibitors with consensus pIC50 values (range 2.00-8.52, median 6.84), assembled from PubChem BioAssay, ChEMBL (assay CHEMBL6111), and BindingDB (UniProt Q9UM07) through a fully scripted curation pipeline. Includes Murcko scaffold annotations, per-compound source-independence scores, the severe activity-cliff network (94 severe pairs), four hub-compound labels (53.2% hub concentration, 4 compounds), a per-scaffold ruggedness ranking (96.8% smooth series), and matched-molecular-pair transformation typology (80/94 severe cliffs MMP-confirmed). Structures standardized with RDKit 2025.09.5. Source licenses: PubChem (public domain), ChEMBL (CC BY-SA 4.0), BindingDB (CC BY 4.0).
